stem: In the rapid primary survey (ATLS-style), at which stage can Brayden’s obvious leg deformity be assessed?
explanation: Obvious limb injuries are assessed during Exposure, after the immediate life-threatening issues of airway, breathing, and circulation have been addressed.

citations.title: Practice Quiz: Emergency Medicine - Trauma 2 - Pain

rationale: In a primary survey, the limb is examined during Exposure once airway, breathing, and circulation priorities are addressed.

optionExplanations.A: Airway assessment focuses on patency and cervical spine protection, not limb examination.
optionExplanations.B: Circulation includes haemorrhage control, but a deformity without active life-threatening bleeding is assessed later.
optionExplanations.C: Breathing assessment is for ventilation and chest injuries.
optionExplanations.D: Disability/neurology assesses consciousness and gross neurological status.
optionExplanations.E: Exposure is where the patient is fully undressed and a head-to-toe exam, including limb assessment, is performed.
optionExplanations.F: Adjuncts are additional investigations/interventions, not the main stage for examining the limb.

Clinical scenario 1 - Braydon

The following six questions refer to Brayden’s clinical scenario.

Teaching/learning points:

Pain relief

Primary survey in context of distracting injury

Paramedics arrive in the emergency department with Brayden, a 12 year old boy. They were called to attend after Brayden lost control of his quadbike (recreational vehicles) while riding around in a field. He was found on his back, alert and screaming in pain. Eyewitnesses stated he had been travelling at approximately 40kph when he lost control at a bend and the quadbike rolled.

Brayden has an obvious deformity to his right lower limb. He was wearing a helmet, which was removed at the scene. He is transported to ED on a spinal board with hard collar in situ. Vital signs are Resp rate 28/min, Sats 100% in air, Heart rate 100bpm, BP 118/65. He has a grossly deformed right leg, with a firm, swollen thigh and he is screaming in pain.
